title: PULPissimo (pulp-platform/pulpissimo)
_note: PULP's single-core microcontroller platform: the PULPissimo SoC itself plus
the dependency IP it is built from -- pulp_soc, the uDMA peripheral family
(core, UART, I2C, I2S, QSPI, SDIO, camera, filter, HyperBus), the HWPE
accelerator stream / control / MAC engine, the cluster interconnect, the SCM
register files, the APB peripherals (advanced timer, interrupt controller,
apb2per, FLL interface), the JTAG and advanced debug blocks, riscv-dbg and
the FPU divider.
The closure IS the work here, and it is Bender's, not a glob:
the shared test/ext_ip/bender_setup.sh installs bender (one prebuilt release
binary, as rocket_setup.sh does for mill / firtool / dtc) and runs
`bender checkout`, which fetches all 38 dependencies at the revisions the
checked-in Bender.lock PINS -- so the closure is reproducible rather than
whatever each dependency's master happens to be.
Two things that step has to do, both upstream quirks:
* adv_dbg_if's own Bender.yml lists `- rtl/adbg_axi_biu.sv,` with a
TRAILING COMMA, so bender looks for a file whose name ends in a comma and
the entire resolution fails with `File .../adbg_axi_biu.sv, doesn't
exist.`  The file is there; only the packaging is wrong.  One character.
* bender checks each dependency out into a directory whose name carries a
hash of its git URL (`adv_dbg_if-1ca7cdfb84c8f5ca`), which would put 25
hashed paths in this manifest.  The setup makes
.bender_resolved/<package> symlinks so roots and incdirs read as names.
sweep_paths covers PULPissimo's own hw/ and the 26 dependency packages that
are NOT already a family of their own; axi, common_cells, cv32e40p, ibex,
fpnew (swept as cvfpu), register_interface, apb, tech_cells_generic,
common_verification and tbtools stay available to every closure but are not
swept again here, so nothing is double-counted.
First local sweep 2026-10-27 (327 rows, MEM_LIMIT_KB=7000000 as the nightly
uses): 205 / 278 comparable proven, 234 / 278 elaborate, 221 co-sim PASS,
266 rows with 0 undriven, 3.1 h of row time.
Open, in the order worth working:
* THREE slang-clean divergence rows -- the real reader leads: ResponseBlock
(301 cycles), clos_net (300) and register_file_3r_2w_be (265).
* 32 rows lose their read_slang reference, and 18 of them to ONE
diagnostic: `use of undeclared identifier 'DATA_WIDTH'` (plus
'STRB_WIDTH'), from the hwpe-stream / interface packages that declare
those as interface parameters.  One cluster, worth one look.
* 9 read-fails, 4 of them one shape: `Module `$paramod\hwpe_stream_fence\
NB_STREAMS=...' referenced but not found` -- a paramod-naming lead.
* 18 rows cannot elaborate; pulp_soc, the SoC itself, is among them.
* SimDTM, SimJTAG and tcdm_model are SIMULATION-ONLY models (DPI, testbench
memory) and their divergences are meaningless -- they should be excluded
the way serv's board tops are.  They are left IN for this first sweep so
the numbers above match the manifest exactly; excluding them is the first
follow-up and will take the row count to 324.
